XRGame Native is not an official Valve client. Sign in only with a dedicated test account, never your main Steam account.\n\nGames are installed to %1$s so they survive reinstalling the app. The next screen asks for All files access for that folder.
SBS uses the gyroscope and simulated hands, without positional tracking. OpenVR games also need OpenComposite. Headset mode requires a working OpenXR runtime.
SBS · Fixed controllers · Touch each half to trigger

A virtual screen for ordinary games, viewed from two fixed eyes. Uses the Vulkan compositor; frame generation is disabled for this session. Gamepad and keyboard work normally; touch acts as a trackpad. Size and distance can be adjusted while playing.
SBS cinema uses trackpad input. Direct touch is unavailable in this preview.
